digest.component_or_area: rebar_reconciler rich-text cutover integration/unit test fixture
propositions: Serial full-suite test execution fails at test_cloud_functions_degrade_without_marklas only when run after test_reconcile_roundtrip integration tests, due to module replacement order dependency
_load_module fixture unconditionally replaces sys.modules canonical key with a new module object, causing AdfCodec to retain a stale module reference while the fixture installs a distinct replacement
AdfCodec.to_wire calls the original pinned module while test assertions target the replaced module, resulting in rich ADF output from codec versus plain ADF from direct function calls
Fix caches modules by both canonical name and __file__ source path, preventing replacement when the same source is requested but allowing different-source replacement for test isolation
The by-path loader pattern affecting four local callers has no behavioral dependency on fresh object creation, enabling safe repair without affecting caller semantics
